name: Amitriptyline
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

key_interactions.effect: Hyperpyretic crises, severe convulsions and deaths (label).

key_interactions.drug_or_class: CYP2D6 inhibitors (SSRIs such as fluoxetine, sertraline, paroxetine; quinidine; cimetidine; propafenone, flecainide)
key_interactions.effect: Tricyclic levels can rise sharply; sudden toxicity (label).
key_interactions.action: Use lower doses and monitor tricyclic levels; allow at least 5 weeks after stopping fluoxetine.

key_interactions.effect: Large rise in amitriptyline levels in some patients (label).

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Anticholinergics, sympathomimetics (including epinephrine with local anesthetics)
key_interactions.effect: Hyperpyrexia with anticholinergics; enhanced sympathomimetic effects (label).
key_interactions.action: Close supervision and careful dose adjustment.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Alcohol, barbiturates and other CNS depressants
